name: lec-lerka
description: Valeriia's personal Claude Code skills, shared across projects

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: PR review that follows each project's own rules and the review history already on its pull requests (Important / Nit findings, each verified, posted inline with a count summary), and safe resolution of a PR's merge conflicts.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Everyday delivery checks for any repo: keep AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in sync with a change, mirror a fix to a sibling app or package that duplicates code, and fix tests that fail on import resolution instead of on their assertions.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Safety hooks for every shell command Claude runs: no pushes to protected branches (main, master, staging, production), no deleting remote branches without asking, no env files, keys or secrets in a commit, a task-tracker reminder after a PR is opened or merged, and a check before finishing that edited code was tested. If a project ships its own copy at .claude/hooks/claude-guard.js, this one steps aside for that session.
